# Model Comparison Website

This site publishes the model comparison analysis from the repository notebook while keeping the tracked notebook source free of stored outputs.

- The analysis page is rendered from `notebooks/model_comparison.ipynb`.
- Outputs are generated during the GitHub Pages build, not stored in the notebook file in the repository.
- The published page includes the executed tables and plots.

[Open the model comparison analysis](notebooks/model_comparison.html)
